landing.hero_subtitle: Saba abaganga b'inzobere mu mwanya w'iminota 30, cyangwa wivugane n'umuganga uri ku murongo nonaha. Kuboneka mu gihe nyacyo, imiti ya digitale, no kohereza mu farumasi — byose ku rubuga rumwe
landing.footer_desc: Guhuza abarwayi, abaganga, ibigo nderabuzima, na farumasi hirya no hino mu Rwanda.
landing.f_smart_booking_d: Kalendari y'iminota 30 hamwe n'amatariki yihariye n'ibibazwa mu gihe nyacyo

landing.f_records_d: Amateka y'ubuzima yose mu kuza kose
landing.f_pharmacy_d: Imiti ya digitale yoherezwa kugira itangwe ihagarikwe
landing.hospitals_sub: Reba ibigo nderabuzima by'abafatanyabikorwa kandi ufate gahunda kuri ko — serivisi, ibice, n'ubushobozi mu gihe nyacyo
landing.pharmacy_sub: Gereranya ibiciro, reba imiti ihari, kandi shungure ukurikije aho ari, icyiciro, cyangwa ubwoko bw'imiti. Farumasi zemejwe zitanga kandi zikohereza — vuba
landing.hospitals_d: Isesengura mu gihe nyacyo n'imicungire y'abaganga
landing.footer: © 2026 MEDICONNECT. Tuzanye ubuvuzi ku ntoki zawe
landing.footer_cta_title: Shaka umuganga cyangwa ufate gahunda yo kwivuza mu minota mike.
landing.footer_cta_sub: Shakisha inzobere, ibigo nderabuzima, na serivisi za farumasi ku rubuga rumwe ruhuza ubuvuzi.
landing.hero_intro: Tangira urugendo rwo gukira hamwe na MEDICONNECT — ubuvuzi bwiza, uko ubishaka.
landing.verified_facilities_sub: Ibigo nderabuzima na farumasi zizewe ziboneka kuri uru rubuga.
landing.team_sub: Itsinda ryacu riharanira kugeza ubuvuzi bufite ireme kuri buri wese mu Rwanda.
landing.pharmacy_banner_sub: Kukugezaho imiti byihuse, byizewe kandi bifite umutekano.
landing.final_cta_sub: Tangiza konsultasiyo ako kanya uvugane n?umuganga mu masegonda make.
landing.faq_consultation_cost_a: Igiciro cya konsultasiyo giterwa n?umuganga n?ubwoko bwa serivisi. Urakibona mbere yo kubika gahunda cyangwa gutangira konsultasiyo ako kanya.
landing.faq_medicine_home_a: Yego. Imiti yanditswe ishobora koherezwa kuri farumasi zanditswe, kandi kuyigeza aho uri biterwa na farumasi n?aho uherereye.
landing.faq_prescriptions_q: Imiti yanditswe ku ikoranabuhanga yemerwa na farumasi?
landing.faq_prescriptions_a: Imiti yanditswe binyuze kuri MediConnect ishobora koherezwa kuri farumasi zikorana natwe.
landing.faq_medication_time_q: Bifata igihe kingana iki ngo mbone imiti?
landing.faq_medication_time_a: Igihe biterwa na farumasi, niba imiti ihari, n?intera. Farumasi yemeza igihe biteganyijwe nyuma yo kwakira ubusabe.
landing.faq_specialists_a: Yego. Ushobora kureba inzobere zihari ukabika gahunda cyangwa ugahitamo umuganga uhari kuri konsultasiyo yihuse.
landing.testimonial_1: Navuganye n?umuganga ntavuye mu rugo mbona imiti yanditswe mu minota mike.
landing.testimonial_2: Imiti yangejejweho uwo munsi. Biroroshye cyane!
landing.testimonial_3: Kubika gahunda byari byoroshye kandi umuganga yasobanuye byose neza.
landing.testimonial_4: Nabonye imiti yanditswe ako kanya nyuma ya konsultasiyo.
landing.testimonial_5: Urubuga rwamfashije kubona umuganga vuba ndi ku kazi.
landing.testimonial_6: Kubona ubuvuzi no kugezwa imiti byari byoroshye kandi bitekanye.
landing.hero_badge: Urubuga rwa mbere rw ubuvuzi bw ikoranabuhanga mu Rwanda
landing.hero_description: Vugana n abaganga bemewe mu masegonda make, ubone imiti yanditswe, ibyemezo, n imiti ikugezwa iwawe.
landing.service_virtual_text: Vugana n abaganga bemewe ako kanya ukoresheje video, ijwi cyangwa ubutumwa aho uri hose.
landing.service_delivery_text: Imiti wandikiwe ikugezwaho neza kandi mu mutekano aho utuye.
landing.service_prescription_text: Bona urupapuro rw imiti rw ikoranabuhanga ako kanya nyuma yo kuvugana na muganga.
landing.service_certificate_text: Bona ibyemezo by ubuzima bikenewe ku kazi, ku ishuri, muri siporo cyangwa mu ngendo.
landing.service_education_text: Soma inkuru, videwo n inama z ubuzima zizewe zitangwa n inzobere.
landing.step_create_text: Iyandikishe mu gihe kiri munsi y umunota umwe.
landing.step_consult_text: Hitamo umuganga maze muhure ako kanya kuri interineti.
landing.step_care_text: Bona imiti yanditswe, icyemezo cyangwa imiti ikugezweho.
landing.specialty_psychiatrist: Umuganga w indwara zo mu mutwe
